text: Bored of pricing five RFPs a day? ... And chasing third-party prices? ... Yeah. We were too.
Well, at Tam, we built something for that.
Meet the all-new Pricing Dashboard. It takes your scope of work, and prices the third-party costs for you.
All you have to do is upload the scope... and the rest is on us. Let me show you how it works.
First, sign in with your Tam Google account, and hit New budget.
Next, you'll need to fill in the RFP details... the title, the client, the project type, the dates, where it's happening, and a short description of what they're asking for.
After that, just upload the RFP. And if it's confidential, don't worry about it. You have options. You can upload screenshots of the relevant pages... or simply explain the scope in writing.

Now sit back. The analyst reads the scope, breaks it into items you can price one by one, and prices each of them. It checks our database first... then similar projects we've done before... and only then does it benchmark. And you see every search as it happens.

When it's done, go through the items. Every line tells you where its price came from, and how confident the analyst is. If a price doesn't feel right to you... just type your own. The original number stays one click away.
And finally, don't forget to save. Every line you confirm goes into our price history... so the next estimate comes out sharper. That's how we get better at pricing, every single week.
Upload the scope... the rest is on us. The Tam Pricing Dashboard.
